verdict.rationale: Supabase documents native Database Webhooks that fire HTTP requests to external systems on INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE table events, built on triggers and the pg_net extension, deliverable to any endpoint including Edge Functions — a first-party webhook subscription mechanism usable by any developer or AI agent (e.g. via MCP's apply_migration/execute_sql tools) to wire up event-driven automation. Missing for 10: independent/community corroboration of webhook usage and no explicit documented AI-agent workflow specifically for configuring webhooks (vs. general Postgres/dashboard setup).
